card.name: Linking words opening a condition
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as if, unless, but, who, on that start a condition or limit clause in warnings and instructions, right after a stated threshold or action.

modes.label: If/unless after an instruction
modes.description: The word if or unless begins a condition after a do-not or discontinue instruction.
modes.example: Do NOT administer and discard the vial<< if>> the reconstituted solution is dis

modes.label: But after a threshold
modes.description: The word but follows a lab limit and adds an upper bound.
modes.example: OMETYX in combination with nivolumab ALT or AST >3 times ULN<< but>> ≤10 times ULN with concurrent

modes.label: Other condition links
modes.description: Words like on, is or who link a rule to the factor it depends on.

card.writes: It weakly suppresses words meaning 'contains' or 'exactly', so the next word is more likely a condition than a content statement.
card.plain: It marks the small word that starts an 'if this, then that' condition in label warnings.
